currentWork.title: Operational evidence accumulation — FINAL.20 OCR continuation maintenance verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.20 is merged and production/live verified. The real-device `Visit vendor mismatch` was caused by visit continuity being keyed too strictly to the first report vendorKey. Related papers now remain in the same visit when they resolve to the same trusted machineId, while each report keeps its own maker/vendor identity. Vendor mismatch still fails closed without trusted same-machine context, and different machineIds still fail closed. Captured images now start OCR automatically; the manual OCR control is retry-only. PR #114 is merged, matching Vercel production is READY, the production continuation gate, OCR field regression, visit-closeout regression, and app smoke pass; GitHub Pages serves FINAL.20 and the live continuation gate passes. Analytics engine is AN14B3B5; DB/schema remain 4.
